---COMPOSE-MAIN---
name: heaven-services
services:
  n8n:
    image: docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n:latest
    container_name: heaven-n8n
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:5678:5678"
    environment:
      - N8N_HOST=localhost
      - N8N_PORT=5678
      - N8N_PROTOCOL=http
      - N8N_SECURE_COOKIE=false
      - GENERIC_TIMEZONE=America/New_York
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - n8n_data:/home/node/.n8n
      - /mnt/c/HeavenServices/data/shared:/files
    mem_limit: 1536m
    cpus: 2.0

  searxng:
    image: searxng/searxng:latest
    container_name: heaven-searxng
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8081:8080"
    volumes:
      - /mnt/c/HeavenServices/config/searxng:/etc/searxng
      - searxng_cache:/var/cache/searxng
    environment:
      - SEARXNG_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8081/
    mem_limit: 1024m
    cpus: 2.0

  stirling-pdf:
    image: docker.stirlingpdf.com/stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:latest
    container_name: heaven-stirling-pdf
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8080:8080"
    environment:
      - SECURITY_ENABLELOGIN=false
      - SYSTEM_DEFAULTLOCALE=en-US
      - SYSTEM_ENABLEANALYTICS=false
    volumes:
      - stirling_configs:/configs
      - stirling_tessdata:/usr/share/tessdata
      - stirling_logs:/logs
      - stirling_pipeline:/pipeline
    mem_limit: 2048m
    cpus: 2.0

  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:2
    container_name: heaven-uptime-kuma
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    mem_limit: 768m
    cpus: 1.0

  homepage:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest
    container_name: heaven-homepage
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:3002:3000"
    environment:
      - HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS=localhost:3002,127.0.0.1:3002
    volumes:
      - /mnt/c/HeavenServices/config/homepage:/app/config
    mem_limit: 384m
    cpus: 0.75

volumes:
  n8n_data:
  searxng_cache:
  stirling_configs:
  stirling_tessdata:
  stirling_logs:
  stirling_pipeline:
  uptime_kuma_data:
